# Variable `UBOOT_FIT_SIGN_NUMBITS`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Size of the private key used in signing the U-Boot FIT image, in number of bits. The default value for this variable is set to “2048” by the uboot-sign class.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-UBOOT_FIT_SIGN_NUMBITS)
